banner.isekai_mahou.steelball.love_train: LOVE TRAIN — THE SAINT IS WHOLE
callout.isekai_mahou.steelball.ball_brea: The rotation wears down even the body's time
callout.isekai_mahou.steelball.golden_ga: On foot, only half the gallop...
The Horse Lesson: power comes from the ground
callout.isekai_mahou.steelball.heart_fou: The Heart of the Holy Corpse has appeared!
callout.isekai_mahou.steelball.love_trai: The Heart of the Holy Corpse has awakened
callout.isekai_mahou.steelball.tusk_act2: Golden Spin: the hole is already on you
command.isekai_mahou.steelball.ready: Ready for lesson "%s": talk to the Master.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.duel.yie: Enough! Enough... *adjusts his hat* Good spin. Very good spin.
Talk to me again: you've earned the lesson.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.d: You have the parts and the Circle. One thing is missing: prove your spin against mine.
When this conversation ends, the challenge begins. Nobody dies — but I won't go easy.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.i: So you're the kid with the ball. Hm. Weak arm, but a good eye.
I'm Rotari. I taught rotation to physicians, executioners and to a rider who crossed the continent.
The spin isn't strength. It's proportion. When you understand that, the ball will return to your hand by itself.
Across the world lie pieces of a buried saint. Each one you gather will change your spin. I'll come back when you're ready — or write.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.m: There's nothing left I can teach. Infinite Rotation is yours.
Now go. A perfect spin never stops — and neither should you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.o: You don't spin, traveler. But that's fine: the saint's pieces help anyone who carries them.
If a Steel Ball writes you a Lesson, maybe you'll learn a turn or two.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.p: The saint's parts lie in Saint's Tombs (the Compass points), sometimes in old chests of other ruins and with bosses. Open the Reliquaries. The Heart is different: it only beats for one who already carries the other 8 — inside a boss.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.r: Very well. You're ready for "%s". Pay attention.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.t: Hold the ball. Spin with the wrist, not the arm. Release when you feel the weight spin by itself... there. Now the nails: the same spin, smaller and faster.
Mount up. Feel the horse: the power climbs through its legs, yours, your spine... and leaves through the hand. The gallop is part of the spin.
The spin that closes a wound is the same that opens a stone. Drive the ball into the ground and let the world spin around it.
You truly beat me. So look: the golden rectangle. The perfect proportion is in everything — the shell, the horse, your hand. Spin in that proportion.
With the saint almost whole within you, the spin no longer needs to end. That is Act 4. Whoever is caught in it never reaches the end of the rotation.
Throw the steel ball or use the Steel Ball form. It comes back: practice until it returns without you thinking.
Use the Steed Whistle. Fight mounted; a mounted ball hits 30% harder.
Nails in quantity, heals with Healing Rotation and a real boss. The spin grows with practice.
Defeat bosses. When you're ready, I'll test you myself.
Use the Golden Rectangle in your spells, fight mounted and face bosses. And gather the saint almost whole.
effect.isekai_mahou.steelball_spun.desc: Rotation has taken the body: slower, weaker blows and, for creatures, uncontrolled spinning.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ball_breaker.desc: Origin effect (homage to Ball Breaker): the perfect golden rotation that WEARS DOWN. The ball's specter hovers over the target for 8 s (×Extend) and ages it every second: growing damage (1 → 4.5 base), worsening Slowness and Weakness, Mining Fatigue and broken defense (Exposed). Bosses wear down slower. Unlock: Lesson V + 7 Parts.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gallop_spin.desc: Origin augment: the horse's power flows into the spin — mounted +40% damage (on foot +10%), your mount surges with it and the Steel Ball flies 40% faster.
glyph.isekai_mahou.golden_gallop.desc: Origin form: mounted, your horse enters the golden gallop for 8 s (×Extend) — Speed III, Jump II, Resistance II and a golden spiral trail; whoever it tramples spins, is thrown aside and receives the effects (80%; with no effects, 3 damage). On foot: half the time, Speed II and a body-check trample (50%). Unlock: Lesson II.
glyph.isekai_mahou.golden_rectangle.desc: Origin augment: the perfect proportion of the spin — +50% damage on what it boosts and pierces +1 target. Hits with it train lesson V.
glyph.isekai_mahou.infinite_rotation.des: G form (Act 4): the golden nail of the perfect spin. The target is trapped in an endless spiral for 10 s — it can't move, spins and takes the spin plus the effects every 0.5 s. +5% power per Holy Corpse Part. Bosses are only heavily slowed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.muscle_lock.desc: Origin effect: the spin contracts the muscles — the target is Rooted and Weakened for 2 s (Extend lengthens). Invert: long Slowness and Weakness without rooting (good against bosses).
glyph.isekai_mahou.rotation_shock.desc: Origin effect: rotation enters the body — Earth damage and the target becomes Spun (stacks up to III). Amplify starts at II. Invert: hurls the target away, spinning.
glyph.isekai_mahou.scan_ball.desc: Origin form: throws the light-studded ball, which stops mid-air and vibrates — 3 scan waves (radius 20, ×Expand; ×1.5 with the Saint's Eyes). Every enemy glows for 10 s (through walls); the 3 most dangerous (+1 per Split) get a WEAK POINT (Exposed II) and receive the effects. Works with no effect. Unlock: Lesson I.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spin_ball.desc: Steel Ball origin form: throws a spinning steel ball that carries the spell and RETURNS to your hand. Holding a Steel Ball gives +6% power per tier. Split = fan of balls; Pierce, Ricochet, Homing and Accelerate apply.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spin_drill.desc: Origin effect: 4 quick piercing hits that leave the target Exposed. On blocks, digs a short tunnel (Expand lengthens; respects arenas and protected places).
glyph.isekai_mahou.spin_heal.desc: Origin effect (beneficial): the physicians' spin closes wounds and removes 1 harmful effect (2 with Amplify), plus Regeneration. Invert, on enemies: damage and removes 1 beneficial effect.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spin_mend.desc: Origin effect (beneficial): the physicians' ultimate technique — heals 10 at once and +2 per second for 5 s, removes ALL harmful effects and conditions (burning, frozen, bleeding...), grants Absorption II and Resistance I for 5 s. Invert, on enemies: 6 damage, strips every beneficial effect and leaves Weakness. Unlock: Lesson III + 4 Parts.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spin_nail.desc: Origin form: burst of spinning nails (3 + 1 per Split, up to 10), each one a copy of the effects. Changes with your Act: Act 2 homes in and leaves Spun; Act 3 — sneaking, you enter the hole and come out behind the target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spin_vortex.desc: Origin form: drives a spinning ball into the targeted ground (up to 24 blocks), creating a 3.5-radius whirl for 4 s. Pulls enemies in a spiral and applies the effects every 1 s (Expand/Extend apply).
G form (legendary) of the whole Saint: for 12 s (×Extend, up to 15 s) you are wrapped in a dimensional curtain of light that follows you. ALL damage and every harmful effect that would hit you become MISFORTUNE and go somewhere else: to the nearest enemy (up to 8 blocks) or, with no one close, to a random enemy within 24 blocks. Projectiles bend away. The spell's effects pulse (1×/s) on whoever receives the misfortune; works with no effect at all. Only what comes from INSIDE the light gets through: domain Sure-Hit, true/void damage and the Golden Spin (Infinite Rotation or Golden Rectangle). Unlock: absorb the Heart of the Holy Corpse (all 9 Parts).
glyph.isekai_mahou.tusk_act1.desc: Origin form (Act 1): your ten nails become bullets — 5 (+1 per Split, up to 10) fired one by one, alternating hands. Each nail flies in a CORKSCREW and makes the target SPIN (Spun and body twisted). Each nail is a copy of the effects (60% power). Unlock: Lesson I + Saint's Left Arm (or 2 Parts).
glyph.isekai_mahou.tusk_act2.desc: Origin form (Act 2): fires the golden nail. Wherever it hits, a SPIRAL HOLE is left that CHASES the enemy for 6 s (×Extend), sliding over everything; when it catches up it bites every 0.75 s (effects at 60%), leaves Spun and grips the feet. Unlock: Lesson II + 3 Corpse Parts.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tusk_act3.desc: Origin form (Act 3): you shoot the nail into YOURSELF, dive into the hole and cross space to the aimed point (24 blocks, ×Accelerate) or to the BACK of the aimed enemy. Inside the hole nothing hits you (2 s shield). On exit, the spiral applies the effects to enemies within 3.5 blocks (×Expand) and leaves them Spun. Unlock: Lesson III + 5 Parts.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.love_train.in: G form: 12 s in a curtain of light — all damage and harmful effects become misfortune and go to the nearest enemy; projectiles bend away. Only Sure-Hit, true damage and the Golden Spin get through.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.rank.1.lesson: Hold the ball, feel the spin, release. The ball always returns to whoever spins it right. Teaches Spin Nail (Act 1) and Healing Rotation; gives the Steed Whistle and the Saint's Compass.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.rank.2.lesson: Power doesn't come from the arm: it comes from the ground, climbs through the horse's legs and leaves through the hand. Teaches Gallop Energy and Muscle Lock. Your nail reaches Act 2 (homing).
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.rank.3: The Spin that Heals and Pierces
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.rank.3.lesson: The same spin that closes a wound opens a tunnel in rock. Teaches Spinning Vortex and Spin Drill. Your nail reaches Act 3 (the hole).
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.rank.4.lesson: Fight the Master for real. Nobody dies: he yields when your spin is better. Teaches the Golden Rectangle and gives the legend Golden Rider's Sphere.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.rank.5.lesson: The perfect spin follows nature's proportion. With almost the whole Holy Corpse gathered, the nail reaches Act 4: Infinite Rotation. Gives the legend Infinite Rotation — Act 4.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.bonus.mou: Mounted: +25%% Spell Power, thrown ball +30%%, mount 20%% faster and immune to fall damage.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.bonus.ret: The ball returns to your hand: catching it restores 1%% Focus.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.bonus.spi: Perfect Spin: +%s%% damage on spells with a rotation technique.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.heart_mis: The last part. It only appears once the other 8 are in your body: then it beats inside a boss defeated nearby.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.heart_rea: The Heart already beats for you: defeat a boss and grab it!
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.hint: The Master shows up by day when a lesson is ready (or use the Master's Letter). The Saint's Compass points to the Tombs.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.other: You are not a Steel Ball: Holy Corpse Parts still grant their powers, but lessons and Acts belong to the class.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.part_miss: Not found yet — Saint's Tombs, old chests and bosses.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tab.title: Master Rotari's Lessons
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.task.ball_hit: Land %s steel balls (throw or Steel Ball form)
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.task.golden_h: Land %s hits with the Golden Rectangle
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tech.hint: Tusk's Acts evolve with the Holy Corpse Parts: pass the lesson and gather the Parts and the technique is learned on its own.
gui.isekai_mahou.steelball.tech.title: Saint's Techniques
legend.isekai_mahou.steelball_ball_break: The steel ball in the Golden Rectangle carries the specter that wears the target down to the end.
legend.isekai_mahou.steelball_golden_cha: The golden nail with the Golden Rectangle: the hole hunts the target, spins it and locks its muscles.
legend.isekai_mahou.steelball_love_train: Love Train — Light of the Heart
The whole Saint's curtain of light: all misfortune goes somewhere else, and whoever receives it spins and has its muscles locked.
legend.isekai_mahou.steelball_wormhole.d: Shoot yourself, cross space and come out spinning and drilling among your enemies.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.compass.n: The needle spins aimlessly... no tomb nearby.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.duel.lost: The challenge is over. The Master adjusts his hat: "Come back when you spin better."
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.duel.phas: The Master spins healing into his own body and his balls turn golden!
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.duel.star: The Master's Challenge! Beat his spin (nobody dies).
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.duel.time: The sun moved and nobody won. "Another day."
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.heart_fou: Inside the boss, something keeps beating... the HEART OF THE HOLY CORPSE! Grab it before it stops.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.heart_hin: All 8 parts are in your body. The Heart isn't in reliquaries: it beats inside a great enemy. Defeat a boss.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.heart_inc: The Heart beats... but something of the Saint is still missing for the light to descend.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.heart_rej: The Heart rejects an incomplete body (%s/%s parts). It wants to be the last.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.love_trai: The HEART OF THE HOLY CORPSE beats along with yours... the Saint is whole. The light descends: you awakened the LOVE TRAIN!
The Love Train fades. Misfortunes redirected: %s.
The Love Train's light is fading (3 s)...
Build Love Train (G form) in the Grimoire — or read the Legendary Scroll "Love Train — Light of the Heart". Uses ultimate charge.
Sure-Hit: the domain pierces the Love Train's light!
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.ar: Master Rotari has arrived: a lesson is ready for you.
A horse approaches at a gallop... an old man in a brimmed hat dismounts and waves at you.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.do: The Master dodges with a spin. "Not outside the challenge."
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.mentor.le: You write the letter and whistle... the Master arrives in a moment.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.outfit: Circle %s: the Master sent the %s outfit!
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.outfit.eq: The new outfit is already on you (the old one went to your inventory).
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.outfit.in: The pieces went to your inventory (you are wearing something else).
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.part_less: You now have the parts for "%s". The Master will want to see this.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.scan: Scanner Ball: %s enemies revealed, %s weak points
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.tech: The Saint's Parts awakened a technique: %s!
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.whistle.b: Your steed is carrying someone else.
message.isekai_mahou.steelball.whistle.n: A racing steed answered the whistle: it's yours now.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.ball.flav: Heavy, polished, perfectly round. It spins in the hand before it flies.
Fire-tempered: the spin never loses strength.
Studded with gold: each dot marks a turn.
Measured in the golden ratio. Whoever throws it never misses the proportion.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.ball.spel: In hand: +%s%% power for the Steel Ball form
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.ball.use: Hold right-click to spin it (up to 1 s) and release to throw. The ball returns to your hand.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.compass: The needle trembles toward a buried saint.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.compass.u: Right-click: points to the nearest Saint's Tomb.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.letter: "When the lesson is ready, I'll show up. If you're in a hurry, write." — R.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.letter.us: Right-click: calls Master Rotari (1 min cooldown).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.outfit.fl: Light racing clothes: banded brim hat, short vest and spurs.
Travel duster, scarf in the wind and the ball bandolier.
Engraved spirals that light up when the spin is perfect.
The Golden Rectangle on the chest and the cape of one who crossed the continent.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.outfit.mo: Hold Shift to see the full set
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.eyes: While sneaking, reveals hostile creatures within 16 blocks.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.fina: The last part of the Holy Corpse — the rarest.
Only fuses with one who already has the other parts (%s/%s).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.flav: They hear the wind before it blows.
Closed for centuries... still seeing what hides.
The last and rarest part. It still beats, slowly... waiting for the rest of the body.
The nails of this hand spin on their own when you hold it.
They walked from one sea to the other.
Steady as one who has thrown a thousand steel balls.
It keeps the Saint's thoughts. Whoever gathers them all, they say, reaches the perfect spin.
Straight as the road that crosses the continent.
Covered in arrow scars that never brought it down.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.hear: +8 max health. With the Saint whole, it awakens the LOVE TRAIN.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.legs: +8% speed and +2 blocks of safe fall.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.love: The whole Saint awakens the LOVE TRAIN.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.owne: You already absorbed this part (you can trade it with a friend).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.righ: Steel balls (throw and Steel Ball form) deal +20% damage.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.part.use: Right-click: the part fuses with your body (once per part).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.relic: A wooden reliquary sealed with gold. Something holy rests within.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.relic.use: Right-click: opens it, revealing a Holy Corpse Part you don't have yet (the Heart is never in a reliquary).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.whistle.b: Right-click: calls YOUR steed to your side.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.steelball.whistle.u: Right-click: calls a tamed, saddled racing steed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.seven_page_beatdown.d: Origin effect (Tusk ACT4 × Valentine): a punch rush that lasts "seven pages" — 28 hits in 2.8 s (Extend = more pages, up to 60). The target is pinned while it's beaten, every punch carries the Infinite Rotation and the last one sends it flying, Spun for 10 s. For Steel Ball, Tusk ACT4 appears punching. Unlocks: Lesson V + 6 Parts.
callout.isekai_mahou.steelball.seven_pag: Tusk ACT4 — seven pages of punches
